comment: the reason is the test's own subject: the create accepts every type, so no
change to the table can make a listed type fail to create. The mutation was
written (renaming lb-s to a type nothing takes) and reported TEST STILL
PASSED, which is the harness saying the guard has no teeth yet rather than
It is kept as a test because it bites the day the create closes on a list,
which is what lbtypes.go's 'Why the create stays open' says is blocked on
the anonymiser preserving the field. A mutation that cannot bite would be
worse than none: falsify would report it green for ever and nobody would
know which of the two it meant.
